candidates.statement: Will the information I report be kept private? The FDA recognizes that privacy is an important concern, so you should know:
candidates.context: • Food or dietary supplement products – report problems to the SRP www.safetyreporting.hhs.gov . Tobacco product, including e-cigarettes (nicotine-containing vapes) and nicotine pouches - report health or product problems to the Safety Reporting Portal (SRP) www.safetyreporting.hhs.gov or call 1-877-287-1363 • Prescription and over-the-counter drugs, therapeutic biologics and biosimilars including monoclonal antibodies, and biologics, such as human cells and tissues used for transplantation (for example, tendons, ligaments, and bone), allergenics and gene therapies.

candidates.statement: • What types of products should I use this form for? The Global Unique Device Identification Database (GUDID) contains key device identification information submitted to the FDA about medical devices that have Unique Device Identifiers (UDI). In collaboration with the National Library of Medicine, the FDA has created a portal, called Access GUDID, to make device identification information in the GUDID available for everyone. For more information regarding the UDI#, refer to the UDI webpage, https://www.
candidates.context: • Your name and contact information may be shared with the company that makes the product to help them better understand the problem you are reporting, unless you request otherwise (see Section F). fda.gov/medical-devices/device-advice-comprehensive- regulatory-assistance/unique-device-identification-system- udi-system • Your report will become part of a database so that it can be reviewed and compared to other reports by an FDA safety evaluator who will determine what steps to take.

candidates.statement: (Check yes if you are including pictures.) No Yes 1. Do you still have the product in case we need to evaluate it? (Do not send the product to FDA.
candidates.context: 2. Do you have a picture of the product? While not required, pictures of all sides of the product will help FDA review your report. We will contact you directly if we need it.)
